definition: Semantic analysis (computational) within applied linguistics and computer science, is a composite of semantic analysis and computational components.
details: Semantic analysis refers to a formal analysis of meaning, and computational refers to approaches that in principle support effective implementation in digital computers.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is Semantic analysis (computational) — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
